subject: pathology
title: Environmental and nutritional pathology

steps.tx: **Environmental pathology** studies injury from physical, chemical and nutritional exposures at work, home and through habits such as smoking and alcohol. Dose, duration and host susceptibility decide harm, and latency hides cause until patterns are recognised. Tobacco remains the single largest preventable cause, driving cancer, vascular and lung disease across organs.
steps.say: Exposures injure by dose and duration with long latency. Tobacco is the largest preventable killer across cancer, vessels and lungs. Pattern recognition links exposure to disease.

steps.tx: **Lead poisoning** impairs haem synthesis causing microcytic anaemia with basophilic stippling, abdominal colic, wrist drop neuropathy and Burton gum lines, while children suffer encephalopathy and developmental loss from pica and old paint. Mercury instead tremors and erodes personality (erethism, Minamata), arsenic causes raindrop pigmentation, Mees nail lines and skin cancers, and cadmium destroys kidney and bone (itai itai pain).
steps.say: Lead stipples red cells, colics guts and drops wrists; children lose development. Mercury tremors, arsenic pigments skin and nails, cadmium breaks kidney and bone.

steps.tx: **Asbestos** fibres inhaled decades earlier cause pleural plaques, asbestosis fibrosis of lower lobes, lung cancer multiplied by smoking and mesothelioma of pleura. Silica instead fibroses upper lobes with eggshell lymph node calcification and raises tuberculosis risk, while coal dust blackens lungs usually with mild fibrosis unless progressive massive fibrosis supervenes.
steps.say: Asbestos scars lower lobes and pleura toward mesothelioma after decades. Silica scars upper lobes with eggshell nodes and tuberculosis risk. Latency hides both.

steps.tx: Nutritional deficiency writes classic syndromes: **scurvy** (vitamin C) fails collagen hydroxylation causing bleeding gums, perifollicular haemorrhage and reopened wounds; rickets and osteomalacia soften vitamin D deficient bone; vitamin A lack blinds by night blindness and xerophthalmia; thiamine lack causes beriberi heart failure or Wernicke encephalopathy in alcohol misuse.
steps.say: Scurvy bleeds gums and reopens wounds without vitamin C. Rickets softens growing bone. Vitamin A blinds, thiamine fails heart and brain. Deficiency syndromes are reversible early.

steps.tx: Obesity and **protein energy malnutrition** are nutritional excess and deficiency poles: marasmus wastes without oedema from total calorie lack, kwashiorkor oedematises with fatty liver and flaky paint skin from protein lack despite calories. Obesity drives metabolic syndrome, steatohepatitis, sleep apnoea and mechanical joint failure, making nutrition pathology bidirectional.
steps.say: Marasmus wastes thin without oedema; kwashiorkor swells with fatty liver despite calories. Obesity drives metabolic and liver disease. Nutrition harms both directions.
